body:
["2.4 Password policy" of MVSP](https://github.com/vendorsec/mvsp/blame/master/packages/mvsp/mvsp.en.asciidoc#L80) mandates `Check existing user passwords for compromise regularly`

[V2 Authentication Requirement 2.1.7](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v21-password-security) states:
`Verify that passwords submitted during account registration, login,`
`and password change are checked against a set of breached`
`passwords either locally (such as the top 1,000 or 10,000 most`
`common passwords which match the system's password policy) or`
`using an external API. If using an API a zero knowledge proof or`
`other mechanism should be used to ensure that the plain text`
`password is not sent or used in verifying the breach status of the`
`password. If the password is breached, the application must`
`require the user to set a new non-breached password. (C6)`

Should we include [this](https://github.com/vendorsec/mvsp/blame/master/packages/mvsp/mvsp.en.asciidoc#L80) as a new Requirement in the next release of ASVS?

The parent of this issue is #1151.

FYI @jmanico

comments.body: Discussion on the topic is carried out in https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/841

title: Support "Check existing user passwords for compromise regularly" Mandated by MSVP "2.4 Password policy"
